responsibilities.quote: Good academic practice involves students improving their note-making and writing skills, being motivated to direct their own studies, seeking advice if in doubt, engaging with and adhering to the University’s guidelines on Artificial Intelligence and any associated development and acknowledging the sources used by referencing correctly.
